title: A Delicious Way to Discover Barcelona
text:
A highly recommended experience for discovering Barcelona through its gastronomy!!!! We tried a variety of tapas and drinks at several charming local venues, while our guide shared interesting facts about the city and Catalan culture.

La Boqueria Market was also amazing to visit. It is a lively, colourful place and a great way to experience the local atmosphere.
We would definitely do it again!
author: Roving566423

title: The Best Tapas Tour in Barcelona!
text:
I can’t think of a better way to truly immerse yourself in Barcelona’s culture and food scene, especially its incredible tapas!

It was just our group of six friends on the tour, so the guide was able to personalize the whole experience for us. We could ask lots of questions and learn interesting facts about the different places we visited.

An excellent experience! We absolutely loved La Boqueria and would happily go back a hundred times.
author: 231yanelam

title: Highly recommended!
text: I had a really nice time on this tour. The guide was friendly and made everything feel relaxed and fun. We stopped at a few different markets and local places, and the food was really good!!
author: queralt0906

title: dynamic and fabulous
text: Great way to discover Barcelona. The markets were very interesting, the food was delicious, and our guide shared lots of local stories along the way. Highly recommended!!!

title: Delicious and knowledgeable tour
text: A wonderful experience to discover the incredible gastronomy of spain. My partner and I were greatly satisfied with the experience and learnt so much from the guide, who did an amazing job.

title: Great Tour!
text: My daughter and I had a great time on our tour. Jessika our tour guide was sweet and very knowledgeable of the city and its history. We got to see and learn a lot from her on the tour as well as eat some tasty local Tapas and food! Would highly recommend this tour and Jessika as a guide!
author: Joanne B
